caption: The LED's 2.0 mW is focused onto a 50 µm core of NA 0.20; only 20 µW enters the guided mode. The lens matches spot size but cannot recover light outside the acceptance cone.

spec.title: Source coupling
spec.aria: Block diagram of source-to-fiber coupling: light from the 2.0 mW LED passes through a lens to the 50 µm core fiber face and becomes a guided mode carrying 20 µW.
